hypothesis: If all domestic pigeon breeds descend from Columba livia and its geographical sub-species, then whole-genome variation in domestic breeds will nest within rock pigeon (C. livia) diversity, with no breed clustering outside C. livia or sharing excess derived alleles with another Columba species.
pass_criterion: Using SNPs called from the linked resequencing reads for domestic breeds, feral pigeons, wild C. livia and an outgroup Columba species: (a) in a genome-wide neighbour-joining or ML tree, 100% of domestic breeds fall inside the C. livia clade (bootstrap >= 90% for monophyly of domestic breeds plus C. livia relative to the outgroup); and (b) ABBA-BABA D-statistics for each breed, tested against the outgroup Columba species, give |Z| < 3 (block jackknife), i.e. no significant excess allele sharing with a non-livia Columba.
fail_criterion: Any domestic breed (or breed group) falls outside the C. livia clade, or sits as a sister lineage to another Columba species (bootstrap >= 90%), or at least one breed shows a significant D-statistic with a non-livia Columba (|Z| >= 3 and |D| > 0.05) that is not explained by a recent feral or livia admixture control.
interpretation: Darwin's 'aboriginal wild stocks' means separate wild species that were domesticated independently. His 'geographical sub-species' is read as the wild and feral C. livia populations. 'Descended from' is read as genome-wide monophyly (phylogenetic nesting) of domestic breeds within C. livia, plus no excess of derived-allele sharing with other Columba species. This is a modern genomic reinterpretation of morphological and breeding-based inference. Limitation: the BioProject page describes the project as a de novo assembly of a single C. livia isolate, and it links about 61 BioSamples and 62 SRA experiments. I take these to include the Shapiro et al. 2013 breed resequencing, but this must be checked before analysis. Outgroup Columba genomes (e.g. C. palumbus or C. rupestris) may have to come from other NCBI records, but the test is run on the dataset's own breed reads.

dataset.name: Columba livia (rock pigeon)
dataset.publisher: NCBI BioProject (submitted by BGI); linked to Shapiro et al. 2013
dataset.why_it_fits: The BioProject links the reference assembly GCA_000337935.2, about 62 SRA experiments and 61 BioSamples, and it is tied to Shapiro et al. 2013 on rock pigeon genomic diversity. SRA run accessions for domestic breeds and feral birds can be downloaded from NCBI and mapped to the assembly. SNPs are then called, and trees and D-statistics are built from them. The BioSample fields breed/isolate and geographic location would define the breed and sub-species labels.
